name: Fresh Canna | 1g Live Resin | Sour Diesel
description: Fuel your day with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Sour Diesel, a legendary sativa powerhouse known for its fast-acting, energizing effects and bold, pungent aroma. Made from fresh-frozen cannabis, this terp-rich live resin preserves the strain’s full-spectrum potency for a smooth, flavorful, and hard-hitting experience. Expect sharp citrus, skunky diesel, and earthy spice in every dab, followed by an uplifting cerebral buzz that sparks creativity, focus, and motivation. Whether you need a wake-and-bake boost or a midday pick-me-up, Sour Diesel delivers pure, high-octane energy that keeps you going strong.
